metadata.title: Clicked like I was lost and somehow got a kill? Valorant, what kind of sorcery is this?
metadata.description:
Just casually clicking like it’s a glitch moment.
Enemy probably uninstalling to figure out what happened.
Valorant logic: ‘Here’s a gift, no questions asked.’
Click if your aim took a day off but the game said ‘Sure, why not?’

Tap if your best plays look like accidents too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
